text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука trains diligently for the
Yayoi Sho,
which has been added to her
schedule as
preparation for the Satsuki
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
During this time, she invites me on a hike
up a
mountain she often visits.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The climb is steep and trying, but what
awaits us
at the top is a grand and vast
view.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We take in the stunning scenery that
Silence
Suzuka so loves. Our bond grows
stronger as we
enjoy the view together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
